thread: Follow clay from the potter's hands through the heat of the kiln and out onto the walls and floors of buildings. The swarm can become a coiled vessel, a glazed shard, or a patterned tile finding its place in a larger design.

candidates.name: The Digital Museum of Taiwan Ceramics
candidates.why: Clay-forming techniques, glazes, fuels and traditional kilns give the swarm hands, tools and fiery chambers to inhabit; exhibitions and collections add a variety of finished forms.

candidates.name: Florida Museum of Natural History
candidates.why: Its digital ceramic type collection offers hundreds of historical pottery types, with sherds, vessel forms, pastes, glazes and decorative motifs to reassemble into creatures.

candidates.name: Tiles and Architectural Ceramics Society
candidates.why: Tile-maker records, identification guides and a gazetteer of architectural ceramics turn the finished clay into patterned surfaces, marked tile backs and creatures attached to buildings.

candidates.name: Regional Ceramics Museum of Deruta
candidates.why: Deruta's majolica, lustre decoration, historic pottery town and excavated San Salvatore kilns offer pots, clay settling vats and fire chambers.

candidates.name: PotWeb, Ashmolean Museum
candidates.why: Ceramic collections arranged across periods and regions contain drinking vessels, burial urns, stoneware and porcelain, with distinctive shapes and painted skins.

candidates.name: TileWeb, Ashmolean Museum
candidates.why: Watercolours of medieval paving tiles preserve fish borders, knights and other designs, organized by buildings and counties for a swarm of patterned floor dwellers.

candidates.name: Tile Heritage Foundation
candidates.why: American tile history, historic manufacturers, architectural terra cotta and mosaic preservation offer a trail from ceramic workshops to decorated surfaces.

candidates.name: Victoria and Albert Museum
candidates.why: Its tile collection ranges from medieval floor tiles and Dutch panels to roof tiles and ceramic stoves, with many designs and forms for creatures to borrow.

candidates.name: Deutsches Museum
candidates.why: The ceramics exhibition traces clay from ancient storage vessels and painted pottery to porcelain and technical ceramic insulators, adding unexpected industrial forms.
